name: legacy_advertising_start

ownership.argument: 48-byte request: owner/id4,advtype4/txpower1/addr6/addrtype1/peer6/intervalu32/flags7/adlen2+ptr/scanlen2+ptr; native start returns0 and writes adv_id at+0

provenance.source: Old BTS advertisement with >=48-byte packed request; unlike generic P67 client. Exact stock producer0xC21A674 builds48 bytes: +4=8, +8=1600, +12=10,+16=30,+44=adv_data,+48=30,+52=scan_rsp,+56=30; after mode8 producer maps scan_interval320 at+20,txpower0xF6+21,phy0+24. No reserved high-mode sentinel.

notes: Exact N66 local producer/consumer recovery. No device result or public-call approval.
